values.value: GL treatment with no GL accounts
SELECT Id, Name FROM blng__GLTreatment__c WHERE blng__Active__c = true AND blng__CreditGLAccount__c = null AND blng__DebitGLAccount__c = null
GL treatment "{Name}" has no GL accounts mapped
Active GL treatment has neither a credit nor debit GL account mapped. Billing entries posted against this treatment will fail to route to GL.

Finds: Active blng__GLTreatment__c records that have neither a credit nor debit GL account mapped. Why it matters: Billing entries posted against this treatment cannot route to a GL account, so revenue, AR, and deferred-revenue postings either fail silently or land in the org's default suspense account. Month-end close shows unmapped entries that finance has to chase down manually. Suppress a finding: when a treatment is intentionally a holding placeholder (e.g. mid-migration cutover from one GL framework to another). Note the cutover date and dismiss. Disable the detector: only if your org uses Billing without integrated GL routing — rare; most orgs that use Billing post to GL.
